thread:
mel: Quick sync — design review for the API + SDK + Console UX work. Want to lock a 90m slot next week to walk through contracts, SDK migration plan, and console flows. Pre-read uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/pages/REV-4321 (tl;dr below). Proposed slots (PT): Tue 11:00, Wed 14:00, Thu 16:00. Reply with which slot works and any must-have agenda items. If you need a dedicated canary/ops deep-dive, flag it here.

raj: Tue 11 works for me.

sam: Wed 14 is ideal — gives me time to finish the SDK migration notes.

jordan: I’m out Tue morning. Thu 16 also OK for me.

evelyn: Heads-up — console team would prefer a separate focused hour for interactive mock walkthroughs (we need live Figma + quick usability checks). If we go 90m for the full group I can compress the mocks to 20m, but might be tight. Suggest we keep the main review and schedule a follow-up console lab if needed.

tia: Quick Q — how deep should reviewers read the pre-read? Just callouts or full pass? Also is there a test plan yet?

mel: Good q — aim for ~15 minutes of prep per reviewer. We expect reviewers to skim API contract and SDK migration highlights and skim console mocks. Leave comments inline on the confluence page. Test plan is draft under the same page (section: Test & QA).

sam: added SDK changelog + migration steps to the confluence page. Also added a short code snippet showing required client changes: ```js
// client update
const r = new RedwoodClient({ apiVersion: 'v2', retryPolicy: 'standard' });
r.startSession({ model: 'rwd-lm-3' });
```

raj: tagging runtime dependency — need Jordan to confirm kernel/quantization constraints. @jordan can you add perf expectations to the doc?

jordan: yup will add perf table (latency p50/p95 and memory) by EOD tomorrow.

mel: pasted minimal pre-review checklist below — please tick/check on the confluence page before the meeting. I’ll lock the slot once we have a clear majority.

```
- [ ] API contract: endpoints, request/response shapes, error modes (Confluence link)
- [ ] SDK migration: breaking changes, upgrade guide, sample code (Confluence + PRs)
- [ ] Console mocks: flows for Create, Edit, Rollout (Figma link)
- [ ] Performance notes: p50/p95 estimates, memory, batch behavior
- [ ] Rollout plan: canary, metrics, rollback criteria
- [ ] QA checklist: integration tests, e2e smoke
```

mel: I also dropped a short calendar poll for folks to pick availability: https://cal.poll/YN6G — please vote by EOD today.

sam: voted. added "API backwards compatibility" as an agenda item.

evelyn: voted too. Also added "console permission edge-cases" to agenda.

raj: voted. added link to PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rfcs/pull/78 (API schema diffs).

ci-bot: Reminder: please attach PR numbers and Confluence comments so the release train can pick them up for the changelog.

mel: Looks like Wed 14 has 3 votes + the SDK owner. Decision: lock Wed 14 PT for the full-group design review (90m). We'll follow with a dedicated 60m console lab next week if Evelyn requests it. Calendar invite to follow with pre-read checklist and required reviewers. If you absolutely cannot make Wed 14, ping me and we can schedule a short async recording slot. Thanks everyone — please finish checklist items and drop comments on the confluence page before Wed 12:00 PT.
